files.manual_read_summary: Adds canonical AgentID validation for payout recipients/member IDs/provenance creators, strict CIDv1 NodeID validation for graph references, deduplicated phi-bound token emission, all-zero CO_AUTHORSHIP stake observability, no-silent-whitespace-normalization, stable top-level input guards, CIDv1-specific provenance/passive-ECU tokens, and Decimal-only ejected-stake member stakes.
Adds WeightParams.decay_rate range validation so temporal decay cannot amplify above one or flip sign below zero, and documents edge_type_coefficient as intentionally not range-bounded.

Adds and hardens Phase 1600 adversarial tests for unsealed batches, top-level malformed inputs, bad epoch counts, malformed/whitespace-padded AgentIDs, malformed CIDv1 NodeIDs, invalid stakes with exact tokens, malformed provenance chains including list entries, phi-bound token deduplication, passive centrality state validation, WeightParams range/non-finite rejection, and ejected-stake member validation.

Migrates settlement-facing passive ECU tests to canonical AgentID and CIDv1 NodeID values while preserving centrality gossip runtime's opaque-node historical coverage.
Keeps CDL-084 historical provenance arithmetic tests useful under current strict AgentID/CIDv1 settlement validation.
Updates Phase 1129 provenance input-hardening tests to current strict AgentID/CIDv1 tokens and fixture shapes.

Updates historical phi-bound tests to canonical AgentID and CIDv1 NodeID fixtures and exact token expectations.
Updates historical H-012 settlement tests to use canonical AgentID and CIDv1 NodeID fixtures under the hardened settlement validation boundary.
Updates REFUTATION and ejected-stake quorum tests to use canonical 96-hex AgentID fixtures.
Updates GAP-ECU-00 runtime sanity tests to use canonical AgentID and CIDv1 NodeID fixtures under strict settle-runtime validation.

Updates Phase 1575t private production soak attribution events to use CIDv1 synthetic star/provenance NodeIDs under current settlement validation.
